method: For each cluster: ids of trailing-window arXiv records whose primary_cluster is that cluster (analysis/classified.jsonl), sorted, then random.Random(42).sample(ids, 15) (see analysis/sample_precision_audit.py). Each title (abstract where needed) was read and judged: is the PRIMARY label a correct description of the paper's main topic? Single annotator (the classifying agent); n=15 per cluster, so each precision has a wide uncertainty (Wilson 95% interval roughly +/-15-20 points); treat as a screen for systematic leaks, not a calibrated estimate.
judging_rules: correct = the paper's main topic fits the cluster label; mere mention of the topic is not enough
methods papers count as correct when the cluster's physics is the stated application (e.g. DMFT solvers for Mott physics)
fallback clusters are judged against their own (broad) labels
